styleSelection.reason: The reference needs legible pen junctions and luminous light local-colour washes. A single base plus selective dry shadow (the fixed ink-and-wash value floor) develops warm walls, cool olives and dark cypresses without repeated whole-sheet middle layers.

families.referenceCue: Small warm hillside buildings and tall narrow cypresses at the top. Pale ochre wall wash on dry paper; roof and window junctions in fine pen, less contrast than the right foreground houses.
Small cool blue-green hillside at upper right, no open sky. One pale connected blue-green wash, little ink, quieter edges and values than the foreground.

Connected olive-green and yellow-green canopy groups separated by warm winding paths. Watery pale wash on dry paper, dry fully, then one connected muted-green shadow glaze; no leaf dots or outlines around every crown.

Ochre sunlit right-hand houses with terracotta roofs, violet-brown left side planes, dark eaves and small rectangular openings. Fine pen junctions, pale ochre wash, then connected dry shadow across adjoining shaded walls and eaves; dark openings last.

Large yellow-green tree left of centre has a visible branching dark trunk against lit canopy. Broad pale warm-green mass; connected dark lower groups over dry wash; slender tapering branch gestures in black pen, clear light gaps retained.

Broken warm paths weave between rounded olive-green shrubs under the houses. Wash planes remain connected; spare dark branch gestures and a cross-crown shadow glaze unify depth, leaving pale warm ground and foliage gaps.
